info.longName: J P Morgan Exchange-Traded Fund Trust - Limited Duration Bond ETF

funds_data.description: The fund mainly invests in mortgage-backed securities, asset-backed securities, mortgage-related securities, adjustable rate mortgages, money market instruments, and structured investments. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds. The fund invests in fixed and floating rate debt securities representing an interest in or secured by residential mortgage loans.
